title: To Certain Fans Of Moulin Rouge The Musical On Broadway… #broadway #m...
transcript: It has come to my attention that some of my words and actions have hurt members of the Moulin Rouge the musical on Broadway fan community. I must humbly say this was never my intent with my words or actions. So I wanted to use this time to give the most humble and heartfelt apology that I could to the Moulin Rouge on Broadway fan community. I'm sorry. I'm sorry that I won't pander to the fact that you like a bad musical. I'm sorry that I think Moulin Rouge on Broadway is for people who never got out of their Glee phase, which was for people who never got out of their Kidz Bop phase. I'm sorry. I'm sorry that your musical only won Tony Awards because nothing else was allowed to be nominated. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for not supporting the show that you love so much that hired us. Predator, in my opinion. Who was convicted for chaining up someone to their radiator and torturing them. I'm sorry for not supporting that. Can I have a second? I think I need to pray. Can you bow your head with me? I'm so sorry that I had an opinion on a musical that I expressed while never telling you. You weren't allowed to have your opinion. Because I know mental health care in this country has been very expensive since Ronald Reagan. So I don't hold it against you that you can't afford the mental health care you Need to work past the issue of making enjoying a Broadway jukebox musical the center of your personality. Please humbly accept this humble apology that I doll out to the Moulin Rouge on Broadway fan community. May god forgive my sins for me not enjoying the musical that expected me to take firework by Katy Perry seriously as I want song. My soul is truly tortured by what I've done to your fan community.
